philosophy: Tier ladder uses ranked WR as one vote alongside patch/kit/build. SmiteBrain = full top-ranked Conquest window; SmiteSource = Masters+ role meta (strong early-OB signal); tracker.gg = high-SR match sample (global god-meta API is 403). Early OB min SmiteBrain matches=25.

smitesource_masters.note: Masters+ role meta aggregated across Carry/Mid/Jungle/Solo/Support. WR is games-weighted across roles; Bayesian shrink prior=20 toward 50%.

tracker_high_sr.note: Sampled high-SR Ranked Conquest matches (not global ladder). Bayesian shrink prior=20 toward 50%.
